summary.prose: Connect completed design reviews to permanent artifact history and ordinary approval without changing the review engine. Preserve every attempt and all feedback, reserve capacity before model work, and remove only approved, fully archived inactive checkpoints through a verified private claim. Qualify normal routes with compiled fixtures and then separately verify the installed daemon with a narrow real review.

Separate aggregate cardinality limits from per-chunk limits in full and impact consolidation, including host diagnostics and carried finding origins.
acceptanceChecks: All accepted model and host-added feedback survives consolidation without truncation; 4097+4097 limitations and >256 combined origins pass when byte-admissible.
Reject unsupported versions, missing/foreign/tampered history; keep S1–S3 semantics and per-chunk model limits.

tests.name: U1 permanent payload integrity and digest; aggregate schemas
I8 full/impact 8194 limitations, >256 finding origins and bounded host diagnostics

tasks.title: Reserve checkpoint capacity before provider dispatch
tasks.summary: Add shared serializer-based bounded reservations before planning, impact, chunk and retry dispatch. Include accepted response, report duplication, aggregate arrays, history and bounded terminal metadata; preserve the fixed checkpoint ceiling.
acceptanceChecks: Exact-bound maximum valid responses persist and consolidate across restart; one-over refuses durably with zero provider calls.

Bound host-added diagnostics and all reservation fields. A checkpoint-capacity refusal is a durable pre-dispatch failure with no model/retry expenditure; end-to-end publication-only capacity retry is implemented and proven by t4, not a prerequisite for t2.

tests.name: I8 exact-byte dispatch reservations, consolidation duplication, refusal and restart

acceptanceChecks: Sync/async readers, journal and writer enforce UTF-8 actual size, escaped envelopes and declared-length preallocation bounds.

acceptanceChecks: Publication ACK follows durable history and receipt; failures keep recoverable checkpoint and pending error.
Exact owned lifecycle delta avoids self-invalidation without masking subject edits; original baseline/Markdown remain immutable.

Publication-only history/frame/journal capacity overflow retains the full checkpoint and pending publication; raising the allowed history limit enables explicit persistence-only retry with zero model calls. This is distinct from t2's fixed checkpoint ceiling, which cannot be repaired by raising the history limit.

tests.name: L1 installed daemon independent review, progress, permanent retrieval and human-approved cleanup

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: U1: Versioned permanent payload validates every attempt, baseline, plan, accepted result, retained finding/coverage origin, model/party, failure/action history and exact preservation digest; missing/foreign/duplicate/tampered data rejects.

U2: UTF-8 frame/journal size policy accepts exact boundaries and rejects one byte over, malformed declared lengths, unsupported versions and oversized unknown/legacy/feedback kinds; only known design records receive the configured allowance within the existing design ceiling.

U3: Version-aware log, artifact-content, delivery and CLI readers preserve legacy display and expose new chunk findings without fabricated claims; current VS Code and JetBrains wire contracts retain existing common fields.

U4: Normal approval requires current complete opposite-party new-format evidence; HIGH/MED, stale body/document/context, same-party, incomplete, invalidated, paused/latest active and missing referenced records block; LOW-only/advice passes; explicit override remains truthful.

I1: Crash/fault injection at journal stage, history append, head replace and checkpoint publication ACK recovers one identical entry/reference with zero model reruns; conflicting replay never overwrites history.

I2: Queued and direct subject changes before/during publication and immediately before approval refuse stale evidence; only exact owned lifecycle metadata is exempt, unrelated source changes are ignored and canonical Markdown is not rewritten.

I3: DEF/HLD/LLD normal MCP/daemon approval and direct LifecycleService approval share the same gate; epic, standalone and issue-linked routes require only their actual documents, while ISSUE/SPEC/PLAN remain human-only gates.

I4: Successful artifact approval cleans only matching inactive fully preserved checkpoints; verify every attempt including older failures, and retain latest unpublished work after override, foreign same-s1/slug records, corrupt/symlink and file-replacement races. Inject replacement immediately before claim, after claim verification and at the old public-path unlink boundary: no public pathname is unlinked, unverified claimed bytes survive in quarantine, and new public bytes remain intact. Inject crashes after claim and before deletion, and exercise no-clobber restore with a replacement present.

I5: Cleanup/start/correction/publication contention on one artifact returns retained promptly, while independent artifacts progress; fixed lock order avoids recursive store queues and no provider or unrelated Git-history replay runs under cleanup.

I6: After cleanup and a fresh daemon instance, exact artifactPath/history reference retrieves the permanent result without a checkpoint or model; missing locator rejects rather than scanning projects.

I7: Both reviewer parties publish S1-S3 fixture outcomes for interruption/recovery, technical retry pause, mutation invalidation, selective retained coverage and final consistency with unchanged semantic results and real provenance.

I8: Before planning/impact/chunk/retry dispatch, checkpoint-ceiling tests at exact and one-byte-over serializer bounds reserve maximum response, consolidation duplication and bounded error/publication metadata. Refused dispatch makes zero model calls and durably records refusal. At the admitted boundary, maximum valid feedback survives save, consolidation and restart without a rerun. Independently exercise permanent-history capacity pending, then model-free retry after raising the allowed history limit; it never repairs checkpoint overflow. Reproduce two individually valid chunks with 4097 limitations each and verify all 8194 survive full and impact consolidation, checkpoint restart, permanent publication and reading. Test derived aggregate maxima and one-over boundaries, bounded host-added diagnostics, and multiple chunks whose combined findings exceed 256 (including carried origins); admitted complete results must consolidate losslessly or dispatch must have been refused before provider work.

S1: Built MCP/IPC and daemon paths exercise DEF/HLD/LLD lifecycle publication, current-subject invalidation, recovery/retry pause, selective correction, approval override/refusal, scoped cleanup and permanent result lookup across restart using labelled fake native CLI responses. Existing compiled code-review smoke stays passing; no legacy flags, raw approval IPC or activation subsystem.

L1: After coordinated daemon update, run a narrow real DEF/HLD/LLD design scenario through insrc_review_step with live progress and permanent result retrieval, then normal registered approval/cleanup after explicit human consent. Record chosen provider/model, measured ACK/progress timings, actual findings/result/history reference and checkpoint disposition; separate hosted calls from fixtures and retain current code-review smoke evidence. A failure is recorded and investigated, not substituted with a fake pass.
